primaryPurpose: 普段使っている複数のChatGPT開発チャットを、スマホPWAからまとめて同時並行・軽量・バックグラウンド耐性ありで操作する
primaryUserFlow: PWAで複数の既存ChatGPT開発案件を一覧する
対象案件へ自由文またはQuick Commandを送る
ChatGPTが実装・デバッグ・GitHub編集を実行する
Workerがキュー・状態・CI・復旧・通知を保持する
PWAから待機・失敗・人間待ち・完了を把握して次の指示を出す

invariants.rule: Multi Chat Remote is the primary product value; Supervisor, Guardian and Autopilot are supporting layers.
The existing ChatGPT development conversation remains the implementation and debugging executor.
External LLM APIs may classify, summarize, route and generate next/recovery instructions, but must not become the repository coding executor.
Durable queue, state and evidence survive PWA closure whenever the platform allows it; recoverable failures are states, not terminal completion.
Completion is evidence-based and never derived only from an AI saying it is done.
Human-only actions are isolated as WAITING_USER / あなた待ち instead of pretending automation succeeded.
Chat transport must not depend on ChatGPT session-cookie theft, scraping, unofficial authentication bypass or secret exposure in the PWA/widget.
No automatic merge or production deployment without an explicit future product decision and human approval boundary.
Mobile-first, low-friction operation is preferred over building a second full IDE or a provider-centric agent platform.

antiGoals: external API autonomous coding agent as the main executor
chat transcript viewer as the primary experience
generic project manager with ChatGPT links attached
provider benchmark or LLM router as the product itself
automatic merge or production deployment by default
